name: SAM-I riboswitch bound to S-adenosylmethionine
affinitySource: Montange RK & Batey RT, Nature 2006; Discrimination study PMC2822714
notes: SAM-I riboswitch aptamer domain from Thermoanaerobacter tengcongensis. SAM ligand: adenosine moiety stacks on G11/A10, methionine tail contacts backbone phosphates of A61/G62. Large ligand (MW 399) with multiple interaction modes; exercises both stacking and phosphate terms simultaneously.

enrichmentSets.description: SAM + adenosine + methionine actives vs filtered ChEMBL decoys. 3-active set; AUC 0.725 at 1k.
enrichmentSets.source: Literature actives + RDKit property-matched decoys (Tanimoto<0.35 vs actives)
enrichmentSets.intendedUse: active-vs-decoy enrichment calibration for aptamer scoring terms

affinityNotes: SAM binds T. tengcongensis SAM-I riboswitch Kd ~100 nM (ITC, Montange & Batey 2006 + variants). >500-fold selectivity for SAM over SAH.
